figurative_meaning_en: to encounter or experience something (often implying its absence or rarity)
similar_in_english: haven't seen hide nor hair of
example_sentences_in_bangla: ব্যবসায় করছি কিন্তু পয়সার মুখ দেখিনি।
এত চেষ্টা সত্ত্বেও সাফল্যের মুখ দেখা হয়নি।
example_sentences_in_english: I've been doing business but haven't seen the face of money.
Despite all the efforts, I haven't seen the face of success.
note: Often used in contexts of unfulfilled expectations, especially financial.
